rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Our Thing
card.instruction: Protect one shared ritual, phrase, or tradition as the living proof that the relationship still exists.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we sign the shop over, two spoons. We always share dessert.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ordered my own. We're allowed separate puddings.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. One shared bite first. We're selling the shop, not us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's coming in a takeaway box. My train leaves soon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll walk you to the station. Keep both spoons out.

card.title: Our Thing
card.instruction: Protect one shared ritual, phrase, or tradition as the living proof that the relationship still exists.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We haven't finished the old handshake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I forgot the last move.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll slow down until your hand remembers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're keeping the taxi waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The taxi hasn't known us as long as this handshake.

card.title: This Is How It Ends
card.instruction: Treat every awkward pause, changed plan, or small disagreement as the possible beginning of permanent distance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You cancelled lunch. Should I leave my key?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have a dentist appointment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First lunch, then the key, then separate dentists.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keep your key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For emergencies or belonging? I'm choosing which ring it goes on.

card.title: This Is How It Ends
card.instruction: Treat every awkward pause, changed plan, or small disagreement as the possible beginning of permanent distance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've moved my chair away from yours. Shall I pack the books too?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was vacuuming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. Clearing my corner first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put it back. You can choose where.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Beside yours. Unless letting me choose means you're keeping your options open.

card.title: A Sign We’re Fine
card.instruction: Interpret every laugh, favor, and familiar habit as evidence that the connection is stronger than appearances suggest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You gave me my chipped plate. We're still us, even with your bags packed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the only clean plate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you gave it to me. Still looking after me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Eat before it gets cold. The gravy's separate, like you prefer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You remembered the gravy too. I'll set your place. We can discuss the bags over dinner.

card.title: A Sign We’re Fine
card.instruction: Interpret every laugh, favor, and familiar habit as evidence that the connection is stronger than appearances suggest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We laughed at the same terrible joke. That's promising.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was just a joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. No effort, no negotiation, still together on the punchline.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We still need to talk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Over dinner? The joke's earned us a table.

card.title: Relationship Maintenance
card.instruction: Accept every emotional complication, then focus on the next concrete act that could make staying connected easier.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can be angry and still choose a Tuesday to talk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A diary won't fix this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. It gives the fixing somewhere to happen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know what I'll say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll start at six with not knowing.

card.title: Relationship Maintenance
card.instruction: Accept every emotional complication, then focus on the next concrete act that could make staying connected easier.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know visiting after our row feels awkward. Would a spare key help?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's not the door. I need to know you actually want me here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fair. I'll invite you for Sunday lunch. The key can wait.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Lunch, yes. But I need to leave by two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two it is. I'll serve pudding at one. No negotiating with you in your coat.

card.title: Those Exact Words
card.instruction: Choose one phrase from the interaction and keep returning to what its wording must reveal about the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your note says I'm 'welcome for now.' Should I unpack?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I meant until your flat's repaired.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why 'for now' instead of 'until the repairs'? Is your welcome wearing out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cross it out. You're welcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: But 'for now' was there before I complained. What happens when I stop asking?

card.title: Those Exact Words
card.instruction: Choose one phrase from the interaction and keep returning to what its wording must reveal about the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said we're still friends. Still?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Friends.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't quietly remove the word after I've heard it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a reassuring word.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reassuring against what, exactly?

card.title: Fate Keeps Reconnecting Us
card.instruction: Treat every coincidence, interruption, and repeated encounter as proof that this connection is meant to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Third time this week outside the bakery. Fate clearly wants us to catch up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We live on the same street.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. It keeps putting us within talking distance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm moving tomorrow. This is my last loaf here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it caught us just in time. Give me your new address before it has to start again.

card.title: Fate Keeps Reconnecting Us
card.instruction: Treat every coincidence, interruption, and repeated encounter as proof that this connection is meant to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We both reached for this coat. First reunion in ten years, and the universe won't let us leave.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's mine. Yours is still on the rack.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it borrowed your coat to stop me missing you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here's yours. Come on, we can share the taxi queue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coats, now taxis. It's arranging this in stages. Where are you headed?

card.title: The Emotional Center
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the emotional center of the room, letting your mood determine what deserves attention and how seriously it should be treated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could we lower the birthday banner? I'm having a complicated morning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my birthday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I'd like to approach it at a manageable height.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we at least sing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Begin softly. I'll let you know when we reach happy.

card.title: The Emotional Center
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the emotional center of the room, letting your mood determine what deserves attention and how seriously it should be treated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before your good news, I need everyone to understand my afternoon.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I got the promotion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Hold that feeling while I finish the parking story.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quite big news.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it deserves me in a receptive mood.

card.title: Composure on Loan
card.instruction: Project steady control while quietly depending on everyone else to stay calm enough for you to maintain it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll chair the delivery meeting. We're in control. Keep your voice just there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The van's missing. I'm trying not to panic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Keep trying. We'll establish its last location.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll fetch the driver. He's shouting in the corridor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Brief him outside first. Then sit beside me and give the report in your voice.

card.title: Composure on Loan
card.instruction: Project steady control while quietly depending on everyone else to stay calm enough for you to maintain it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The wedding's under control. Tell me about the cake in that lovely calm voice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's leaning. I can hold the stand level.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. A minor adjustment. Keep talking like that while you hold it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you'll have to help. My hands are shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. We'll steady it together. You count us in; your voice hasn't started shaking.

card.title: Fluent in Feelings
card.instruction: Treat every reaction as evidence you can expertly interpret; translate feelings, correct emotional misunderstandings, and prescribe the proper response.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said dinner was fine while folding your napkin. That's guarded resentment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It means the napkin was untidy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're restoring order because you feel unheard. Tell me what you needed from dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: To eat without being analysed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good boundary. Now say it without hiding behind the napkin, so I can acknowledge it properly.

card.title: Fluent in Feelings
card.instruction: Treat every reaction as evidence you can expertly interpret; translate feelings, correct emotional misunderstandings, and prescribe the proper response.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're laughing very quickly at my joke. Nervous about meeting my parents?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No, your dad's impression was funny.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's approval-seeking. You can let a joke pass without earning your place.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you pass the biscuits? I missed lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Comfort-seeking now. Before the biscuit, tell yourself you're welcome here without bringing anything to the table.

card.title: Earned My Place
card.instruction: Treat what you have endured as proof that you belong here and deserve patience, access, and a voice in what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I worked through three winters to open this shop. Leave me a chair at the meeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only investors are invited.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My cracked hands invested before the cheque books arrived.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need a contribution record.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the winters. I'll provide the dates.

card.title: Earned My Place
card.instruction: Treat what you have endured as proof that you belong here and deserve patience, access, and a voice in what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've waited six months for this audition. I'm entitled to finish the song.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We only need a verse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give the verse room for six months of getting here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone waited.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You'll understand why I'm not rushing the last note.

transfer.action: I make room for {prop} between our two dessert spoons.
transfer.opening: We still do two spoons. That's ours. {request}
transfer.response: Business can wait until we finish our little ritual. {counter}
transfer.closing: That's how a ritual becomes something we used to have.

transfer.action: I start wrapping the keepsake beside {prop} after a small silence.
transfer.response: Is this one cancellation or the start of all of them? {counter}
transfer.closing: No. I'm trying to finish wrapping before you do.

transfer.action: I put {prop} beside the chipped plate with a hopeful smile.
transfer.opening: You remembered this one. We're not strangers. {request}
transfer.response: There's still a joke only we find funny. {counter}
transfer.closing: No. It leaves one small thing still belonging to us.

transfer.action: I open the diary beside {prop} and make space for two cups.
transfer.opening: We can feel all of this and still pick a Tuesday. {request}
transfer.response: Let's make the next visit workable, not perfect. {counter}
transfer.challenge: I don't know how I feel.
transfer.closing: Then arrive unsure at six. I'll have the kettle on.

transfer.action: I underline two small words beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: You said for now. Why those two words? {request}
transfer.response: Still welcome has a lot of space before still. {counter}
transfer.challenge: You're reading too much into it.
transfer.closing: Then help me understand why I can't put those two words down.

transfer.action: I add {prop} to my map of our accidental meetings.
transfer.opening: Third time this week. The map's getting insistent. {request}
transfer.response: Even the coat rack has arranged another meeting. {counter}
transfer.closing: A remarkably persistent arrangement for two people avoiding a conversation.

transfer.action: I put {prop} beside the celebration banner and turn the banner facedown.
transfer.opening: I'm not ready for the happy part yet. {request}
transfer.response: Let's start with the bit I can bear hearing. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then they can begin by making room for the person who isn't.

transfer.action: I steady {prop} with both hands and count one slow breath.
transfer.opening: Nothing sudden, and I can lead this. {request}
transfer.response: Keep the next sentence slow enough for my hands. {counter}
transfer.closing: I am, while the room cooperates with being manageable.

transfer.action: I label the pause beside {prop} on my notepad.
transfer.opening: That sounds like frustration wearing a polite coat. {request}
transfer.response: I'm translating the feeling, not criticizing it. {counter}
transfer.challenge: Can't you take my words literally?
transfer.closing: Then explain why your shoulders keep supplying a different sentence.

transfer.action: I put {prop} beside the worn shoes that got me here.
transfer.opening: I've already done the difficult part of belonging. {request}
transfer.closing: Then leave space for the person whose difficulties have arrived at your table.
